cases.description: A --- line after a blank line inside a body is a thematic break (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.1) and stays in $body.
Lines that look like front matter inside a body are a thematic break and a setext heading (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.1 and 4.3), so they give a section titled 'status: Open' and no field.
A --- line right after an ATX heading cannot underline it, since only a paragraph becomes a setext heading, so it is a thematic break in the section's $body (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.1 and 4.3).
Only the --- at byte 0 opens front matter, so a later --- line followed by a key and a value is a thematic break and a paragraph in $body, and adds no field.
